readme_material_lines: - Material: **PETG** (nozzle 240 °C, bed 80 °C, softens ~70 °C — default: stiffness + heat resistance)
- Orientation: hub face down on the bed (blades sweeping up) — minimizes blade overhang
- Cooling: max part cooling for PLA/PETG bridging thin edges; reduce for ABS to avoid warping
*Print at your own risk — printed blades are a relative-comparison baseline, not a Noctua replacement. Tip clearance and balance matter; spin up gently the first time.*
